purpose: Reject non-finite DWG RAY and XLINE origins or direction vectors before publishing output.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: Both entities carry a 3BD point and a 3BD vector; XLINE uses the same body as RAY except for its type code.
authority.consistencyEvidence: The shared bounded DWG parser already refuses non-finite point/vector components.

implementation.behavior: The shared RAY/XLINE DWG encoder requires finite origin and vector components before it stages output. It does not change the existing zero-vector policy.
implementation.scope: Writer admission only; reader behavior unchanged.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Each refusal preserves a seeded destination; corrected same-writer output reads back the exact origin/vector with zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: All drawings are generated in scratch storage; no fixture was added.

limitations: This is bounded writer refusal/retry/readback evidence, not native ray/xline behavior or source prevalence.
The broader P6 no-loss and whole-document gates remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes a bounded DWG RAY/XLINE finite-field writer gap; no broad support claim is promoted.
